messages:
marta: Heads-up — Sales forwarded an AtlasHealth security questionnaire. They want RBAC change logs (6 months), tenant audit export for 2025-06-01..2025-06-30, KMS key provenance + rotation history, evidence of vuln triage for critical/high, and a redacted postmortem within 1 year.

owen: paste the asks so we can scope.

marta: pasted excerpt:
- RBAC: change request records + approver attestations (PDFs preferred)
- Audit logs: export for tenant atlashealth 2025-06 (manifest + checksums + tamper-evidence)
- KMS: key creation events, who created keys (user or automation), rotation schedule, HSM status
- Vulnerability mgmt: triage timestamps and sample tickets for critical/high in last 6 months
- IR: redacted postmortem and runbook excerpt

chun: i can own logs export + manifest. our export tool:
```
$ infractl export-logs --tenant atlashealth --start 2025-06-01 --end 2025-06-30 --out atlashealth-jun-2025.tar.gz
```
We publish manifest and record manifest hash in log-index. ETA ~3h for full export (tenant has ~40GB for the month).

owen: i'll grab RBAC approvals from approvals-bucket/org-access/teams/*/2025/ and produce redacted PDFs. Note: service-account approvals will be marked as automation and explained in metadata.

security-bot: NOTE: platform retention default for enterprise tenants = 400 days; object-locking and manifest signing applied when export requested.

chun: started export job. job id job-99221. will post sha256 when done.

marta: KMS provenance — ask if they need notarized signatures. Legal usually prefers a signed attestation letter + CloudTrail event exports. We cannot notarize internal emails. @legal can confirm language.

legal: confirm — provide CloudTrail JSON events (eventId, eventTime, userIdentity) and a signed attestation from Security Director. If customer insists on notarization, route via legal and schedule.

owen: RBAC PDFs may have an SSO ghosting issue for one approver (2025-02-18). HR verified identity; we'll include a metadata note linking to HR confirmation (redacted).

chun: export complete. artifact: s3://evidence-exports/atlashealth/2025-06/atlashealth-jun-2025.tar.gz
sha256: d4f8c2a7b9e3c6d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f89a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4
manifest: s3://evidence-exports/atlashealth/2025-06/manifest.json (per-file sha256 listed). manifest-hash recorded in log-index at idx-2025-06-30-0042.

marta: IR artifact — we have a redacted postmortem for 2025-03-14 incident (autoscaler race). i'll redact tenant ids and upload to s3://evidence-redacted/atlashealth/ir/postmortem-2025-03-14.pdf

owen: RBAC PDFs uploaded: s3://evidence-redacted/atlashealth/rbac/req-12011.pdf, req-12056.pdf. automation approvals marked in metadata.

marta: KMS CloudTrail bundle ready: atlas-kms-provenance-2025-06.zip
sha256: a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9
sample event: evt-9f8e7d6c-2025-06-12T08:11:22Z userIdentity: arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/infra-keygen (automation)

marta: draft cover note to AtlasHealth: "Hi AtlasHealth security team, attached is a preliminary redacted evidence bundle covering your questionnaire: RBAC approvals (redacted PDFs), audit log export with manifest and checksum, CloudTrail events for KMS key provenance, sample vuln triage tickets, and a redacted incident postmortem. We can provide additional raw artifacts or a signed attestation letter from our Security Director on request."

legal: add short note about redaction: "Customer-identifying data removed; system timestamps and event identifiers preserved."

marta: action items: owen (RBAC PDFs + HR note), chun (logs + manifest), legal (attestation language), marta (assemble bundle and hand to sales). aim to deliver draft bundle to sales by 2025-07-05 EOD.

security-bot: queued pack command: /evidence pack --scope=rbac,logs,kms,vuln,ir --tenant=atlashealth --out=atlashealth-evidence-draft-2025-07-05.tar.gz

marta: thanks all — drop links and i'll assemble.
